## Emerald 2.3.0-dev.1

This prerelease makes Read Mode navigation feel more like returning to a place
in a book. Development-channel users can install it through
**Settings → Updates → Check for Updates…**.

### Remembered reading positions

- Every note now remembers its source-backed reading position across note
  changes and application restarts.
- Back and Forward restore the exact reading position saved in each history
  entry, including the source line and its viewport offset.
- Positions remain stable when Read Mode rendering, line wrapping, or external
  file changes alter the document height.
- Renaming or moving notes preserves their saved positions, while deleting
  notes or folders removes stale entries.
- Same-note heading links remain in-page movements: they do not create another
  history visit or restore an older position.

### Read Mode navigation

- Press `g` to jump to the top of the note.
- Press `G` to reveal the last written line at the bottom of the viewport. It
  no longer moves into Emerald's optional scroll-past-end area.
- Press `i` to open a filterable **Note index** listing Markdown headings in
  source order and indented by level.
- Duplicate heading names remain separate and open their exact occurrence;
  headings inside fenced code and comments are excluded.
- Closing the index restores keyboard focus to the previous control.

### Testing notes

- Scroll midway through a long note, follow links to other notes, and use Back
  and Forward; each visit should return to its own saved location.
- Restart Emerald and confirm previously visited notes retain their reading
  positions.
- Verify `g`, `G`, and the filterable `i` index in notes with wrapped text,
  duplicate headings, folds, tables, and images.

### Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux (x86-64) | `Emerald-x86_64.AppImage` | `chmod +x` and run |
| Linux (ARM64) | `Emerald-aarch64.AppImage` | requires glibc 2.39 or newer |
| macOS (universal) | `Emerald-macOS.dmg` | drag to Applications; first launch **right-click → Open → Open** |
| Windows | `Emerald-win64-setup.exe` | installer with Markdown **Open with** registration |
| Windows portable | `Emerald-win64.zip` | extract and run `emerald.exe` |
